title: Expected Batch Optimal Transport Plans and Consequences for Flow Matching
tldr_zh: 期望 batch OT 耦合 π̄_k 在半离散情形有成本 O(k^{-1/2})、plan O(k^{-1/4}) 收敛速率，FM 速度场良定；增大 batch 主要改善低 NFE 采样。
tldr_en: Expected batch OT plan converges at O(k^{-1/2}) cost bias and O(k^{-1/4}) plan rate in semidiscrete case; FM velocity field is well-posed; larger batch mainly helps low-NFE sampling.
